exposure: Ovarian cystic fluid cytology diagnoses (nondiagnostic, negative for malignancy, atypical, suspicious for malignancy, malignant)
outcome: Surgical pathology diagnosis (malignancy including borderline tumors)
Sensitivity of ovarian cystic fluid cytology
Specificity of ovarian cystic fluid cytology
cohort: The study cohort consisted of 507 ovarian cyst fine-needle aspiration cases from a single institution between 2013 and 2023.
finding: Ovarian cystic fluid cytology demonstrated moderate sensitivity (45.4%) and high specificity (100%) in detecting malignancy when compared to surgical pathology diagnosis.
